title: A water-based synthetic route to the metal–organic framework UiO-66 starting from PET-derived terephthalate esters
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2026, 4,466-476
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00463B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pietro Agola, Marco Taddei
The benchmark Zr-terephthalate metal–organic framework UiO-66 was prepared under mild conditions in an aqueous medium by controlled in situ hydrolysis of terephthalate esters that can be derived from chemical recycling of PET.
